title: CERT-In Vulnerability Note  CIVN-2026-0405
content:
CERT-In Vulnerability Note 
                                                                      CIVN-2026-0405
Multiple Vulnerabilities in Progress Kemp LoadMaster
Original Issue Date:August    12, 2026
Severity Rating: CRITICAL
Software Affected
Progress Kemp LoadMaster version GA v7.2.63.1 and older
Progress Kemp LoadMaster version LTSF v7.2.54.17 and older
Overview
Multiple vulnerabilities have been reported in Progress Kemp LoadMaster that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands or bypass file upload security controls on the targeted system.
Target Audience:
All organizations and individuals using affected versions of Progress Kemp LoadMaster.
Risk Assessment:
High risk of remote code execution, unauthorized access and security control bypass.
Impact Assessment:
Potential for arbitrary command execution and bypass of security controls.
Description
Progress Kemp LoadMaster is an application delivery controller and load balancing platform used to manage and distribute network traffic across applications and services.
Multiple vulnerabilities have been reported in Progress Kemp LoadMaster due to improper neutralization of special elements used in commands and improper validation of filenames during file upload processing.
Successful exploitation of these vulnerabilities could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands or bypass file upload security controls on the targeted system.
Solution
Apply appropriate updates as mentioned by the Vendor:
https://community.progress.com/s/article/LoadMaster-Critical-Security-Bulletin-June-2026-CVE-2026-8037-CVE-2026-33691
